note: As of 2026-09-27: availability (BK-11), create-booking (BK-22), get/list bookings (BK-23) and M-Pesa deposit payment (BK-31/32) are live and wired in the app (src/api/availability.ts, src/api/booking.ts). USE_MOCK_BOOKING_PAYMENT=true simulates payment without M-Pesa. There's no cancel endpoint yet; Appointment Detail tells the customer to contact the business.

endpoints.description: Which days are open and have at least one bookable slot. serviceIds is repeated once per service in the cart (required). staffId is optional; omit it for 'Any available'. from defaults to today in the business's timezone; days is 1-31 (default 14).

endpoints.description: Bookable start times for one day. durationMinutes is the sum of the chosen services. time is business local time (show as-is); startsAt is the same moment with its UTC offset. staffIds lists who is free for that slot; with no staffId the booking is left unassigned, so staffIds is only a hint. Slot grid and lead time come from booking settings (default every 15 min, earliest 30 min from now).
endpoints.errors: same as get-availability-days (except the days range)

endpoints.description: Send only what the customer chose: names, prices, totals and the deposit come from the server. staffId null = 'Any available' (left unassigned for the owner to assign). time must be one of the slots from get-availability. No deposit: status confirmed. Deposit due: status pending_payment, and the slot is held until expiresAt (10 minutes). expectedTotal is optional: send the total the customer saw, and if prices changed you get 409 price_changed with the new total instead of a booking. The app sends it always; on price_changed it shows the new total and resends it as expectedTotal when the customer confirms again. On slot_unavailable it returns to Select Date & Time.

endpoints.description: The same Booking shape create-booking returns. depositPayment is null until a deposit payment is started, then { paymentId, status: pending | succeeded | failed | timeout, failureReason: cancelled | insufficient_funds | wrong_pin | timeout | busy | provider_error | failed }. paymentReference (M-Pesa receipt) and paymentMethod 'mpesa' are set once it succeeds. An unpaid booking whose hold ran out shows status cancelled with cancelReason payment_expired. paymentStatus is unpaid | deposit_paid | paid. STK Push Pending polls this every 3s while paying.

endpoints.description: filter: upcoming = pending_payment, confirmed or in_progress and not yet over, soonest first. past = completed and no_show, plus confirmed bookings whose time has passed, newest first. cancelled = newest first. limit 1-50 (default 20). Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page; it's null on the last page.

endpoints.description: Sends the M-Pesa prompt for a pending_payment booking's deposit. phone is optional (defaults to the phone on the booking; any Kenyan format). Returns 202 immediately, while the customer enters their PIN. Then poll GET /bookings/{bookingId} every 3 seconds until status is confirmed (paid) or depositPayment.status is failed/timeout; stop after about 2 minutes. On failure the customer can try again (a new prompt) until expiresAt. At most one prompt per 2 minutes and 5 per booking. The money goes straight to the business's own till, paybill or bank. App: PaymentMethodScreen starts it (on payment_in_progress / already_paid / no_deposit_due it goes straight to polling); StkPendingScreen polls and routes per `pollingOutcomes`.
